title: Bullard and the African with filed teeth
summary: Bullard backed down from a fight with a tall African with sharpened teeth.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: There was an African called Fia (phonetic). Pierre. Well, this African whatever tribe it was, they had their teeth sawed down and they looked like shark teeth.

Well, so it seems that he and Gene/Bullard had a little trouble and this Fia got excited and said, (verbally demonstrating) you want to fight me, you fight me, he grabs Gene -- (verbally demonstrating) -- and had them teeth posed -- Gene cut out and said I don't want to bother with you, you ain't nothing but a savage, I don't want to bother with you. He said come brother, come brother, let's talk to your savage brother, come. Oh, no. The savage -- -- and that was that scene.
